statement: If F_z(q)=0 for all q in the local observed patch, then B_QK(q)=0 throughout that patch.
proof_sketch: B_QK=partial_q partial_z S=partial_q F_z; differentiating the identity F_z(q)=0 gives zero.
remaining_gap: requires parent-owned zero-section family, not just one tuned local point

statement: The Fisher/KL fibre core gives F_1=0 and B_QK=0 while retaining M_K=Theta_H I_H.
proof_sketch: D_KL has no linear term at the reference distribution; q derivatives of that zero linear term remain zero.
remaining_gap: requires p_z, p_0, Theta_H, I_H, and units to be parent-owned

statement: A positive Fisher matrix supplies a kernel-sector gap without introducing a q-z mixed Hessian at z=0.
proof_sketch: M_K,core=Theta_H I_H can be positive even when B_QK,core=0.
remaining_gap: requires matching M_K or Xi_H to the actual local sector gap

statement: Any non-Fisher odd correction or boundary mixed term must be theorem-zero or retained as a finite coefficient.
proof_sketch: The total F_1 and B_QK rows reduce to correction and boundary rows once the Fisher core is accepted.
remaining_gap: requires numeric/source rows for retained corrections before local-GR promotion
